 Judgment

This appeal is filed under Section-173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act 1988 (hereinafter referred to as 'MV Act' for brevity) by the appellant-insurance company, calling in question the judgment and award dated 31.03.2011, passed in M.V.C.No.1068/2007, on the file of the Senior Civil Judge And Additional Motor Vehicle Accidents Claims Tribunal at Kundapura (hereinafter referred to as 'the Tribunal' for brevity).

entities.text: Senior Civil Judge And Additional Motor Vehicle Accidents Claims Tribunal at Kundapura
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Brief facts:
2. On 26.01.2005 at about 5.00 a.m., the deceased Rama Kotegar was proceeding from Kundapura towards Dharmasthala in a Motor cycle bearing registration No.KA-20-Q-8399 driven by himself, when he reached a place near Keremoole of Kuvettu Village, Belthangadi Taluk, the motor cycle skid and rolled down on the road and deceased fell down and sustained severe injuries and thereafter succumbed to the injuries.
The Branch Manager vs Gopal Kotegar on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/145160200/
2 3.
Hence, a claim petition was filed by the legal heirs of the deceased under Section-163-A of the M.V. Act, claiming compensation for the death of the deceased in the road traffic accident.

The Tribunal on appreciating the materials on record,
allowed the claim petition in part, and awarded a compensation of Rs.50,000/-,
along with interest at 6% per annum from the date of petition till the date of realisation.
The Tribunal held respondent Nos.1 and 2 therein, jointly and severally liable to pay the compensation.

4. Heard arguments of the learned counsel for the parties and perused the materials on record.
5.
The Tribunal has granted compensation of Rs.50,000/- under Section-140 of the M.V. Act on the principle of no fault liability.
In the present case, the deceased while riding the motor cycle skidded and fell on the road and succumbed to the injuries.

The Tribunal by following the judgment of the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of NINGAMMA AND ANOTHER -V- UNITED INDIA INSURANCE COMPANY LIMITED1 and opined that the legal heirs could not make claim under Section- 163-A of the M.V. Act.

entities.text: NINGAMMA AND ANOTHER -V- UNITED INDIA INSURANCE COMPANY LIMITED1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Thus, the claimant is not entertained under Section-163A of M.V. Act but granted (2009) 13 SCC 710 compensation under Section-140 of M.V. Act on the principle of no fault liability.
6. On perusal of the records and under the facts and circumstances of the case, the Tribunal has correctly considered and awarded the compensation.
Hence, it needs no interference by this court.
Therefore, the appeal filed by the insurance company is liable to be dismissed.

7. Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER i. The appeal is Dismissed.
ii.
The impugned judgment and award dated 31.03.2011, passed in M.V.C.No.1068/2007, on the file of the Senior Civil Judge And Additional Motor Vehicle Accidents Claims Tribunal at Kundapura is upheld.

entities.text: Senior Civil Judge And Additional Motor Vehicle Accidents Claims Tribunal at Kundapura
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: iii. The observations and findings made by the Tribunal in the aforesaid impugned judgment and award are kept intact.
iv. The amount in deposit by the Insurance company shall be transmitted to the Tribunal forthwith.
v. The appellant - Insurance Company is directed to pay the amount of total compensation to the claimant within Eight Weeks from the date of receipt of the certified copy of this judgment.

vi.
Registry is directed to return the Trial Court Records to the Tribunal, along with certified copy of the order passed by this Court forthwith without any delay.
